summary.tldr: Requires the health minister to develop a national framework on sickle cell disease, with standards, research, screening, awareness and reporting.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of Health to develop a national framework on sickle cell disease.
Includes measures for training, education, and diagnostic and treatment tools for health care professionals.
Creates a national research network, improves data collection, and establishes a national registry on sickle cell disease.
Sets evidence-based national standards for diagnosis and treatment, and measures for equitable access to newborn screening, diagnosis and results.
Includes measures to support public awareness campaigns and an analysis of a tax credit for people with sickle cell disease and their caregivers.

Requires the minister to consult other ministers, provincial and territorial governments, and stakeholders, then table the framework in Parliament within one year and report later on what was implemented.
summary.background: Sickle cell disease is also known as sickle cell anemia or drepanocytosis.
